## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Sui-dynasty commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* by **Guàndǐng** 灌頂 ([灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82), 561–632), the principal disciple-redactor of **Zhìyǐ** 智顗 ([智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97)). The relationship to [KR6k0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0078) (which is also attributed to Guàndǐng's redaction of Zhìyǐ's teaching) reflects the complex transmission of Tiāntái commentary literature: this independent work appears to be Guàndǐng's own commentary as distinct from his recording of Zhìyǐ's teaching.

**Abstract**

Guàndǐng's independent commentary represents the **second-generation Tiāntái scholastic** treatment of the *Fànwǎng* tradition, building on Zhìyǐ's foundational teaching but extending the doctrinal exposition into more systematic scholastic form. Together with [KR6k0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0078), it is one of the foundational Tiāntái texts on the bodhisattva-precepts.
